title: Atlanta's Premier M&A Advisory Firm and Business Brokerage
description: Andrew Neitlich Founder and CEO The Center for Executive Coaching "John Marsh and Marsh Creek Advisors provide an amazing service, one that can only be described as life changing. I worked with him to sell my business and he led me through the process masterfully. Only a handful of businesses successfully sell. If you want to sell your business, you need the right professional in your corner and John is exactly that. John did an excellent job valuing my business, marketing it to the right buyers, and — most importantly — helping me navigate the stressful process of negotiating and preparing for sale. There were a number of times during this process when I felt stressed and unsure, and John helped me through those times. Most importantly, he put my needs first and only wanted me to move forward if I was excited about the deal. If you are going to sell your business, you need an expert and consummate professional working on your behalf. John has all the skills and knowledge needed: valuation, negotiation, marketing, deep knowledge of deal structure, referrals to attorneys and tax planning/financial pros in this space, and the social intelligence needed to help a business owner navigate and get through what can be a stressful and complex process. Working with John is like getting to work with a major Wall Street investment banker, but focused on businesses like yours. My attorney told me I hit the lotto when I selected John and Marsh Creek Advisors as my business broker/M&A expert, and I agree 100%. If you are selling your business, you want John on your team. Obviously, I highly recommend him and his work.

title: Stop being the last step ineveryprocess.
description: SUPPORTING THE FULL LIFECYCLE OF THE DEAL The quality of what happens upstream determines the quality of what is possible downstream. A deal does not start when a seller calls. It starts with whether the seller called you or someone else. And why. How that moment is set up determines the quality of everything that follows: the listing conversation, the buyer process, the close, and the next referral. BEFORE THE DEAL Getting sellers to call you before they call anyone else The quality of the listing conversation is determined before it starts. A broker with the right system does not compete for attention. They create the conditions under which the right sellers find them first, already convinced. By the time a seller reaches out, the competition has already been removed from the equation. Lead Capture Seller Nurture Sequences Education Funnels Lead Source Tracking THE LISTING CONVERSATION Walking in with the work already done When the upstream work is done correctly, the listing conversation is not an interview. The broker is assessing fit. The seller is confirming that what they encountered before the conversation is true in the room. The process, the valuation education, the onboarding approach... all of it has already made the case. Seller Onboarding Valuation Education Virtual Data Room Marketing Material INSIDE THE DEAL A system that moves deals forward without pulling the broker into every step The broker's attention goes where it actually changes the outcome. That is only possible when the system has handled everything that does not require the broker's judgment. A buyer who has reviewed the CIM, watched the seller interview, signed the NDA, and submitted questions before the first call is an entirely different buyer. The broker's first conversation with that buyer is the introduction to the seller. Let us take the reins so you can focus on what matters most. Business Valuations Whether you need a valuation for exit planning, litigation, or acquisitions, our accredited valuation analysts provide precise and reliable valuations. We'll give you a clear understanding of your company's true value in today's market. Buying a Business Ready to take the next step and buy a business? Our team of experienced advisors will help you find the perfect opportunity and navigate the complex buying process. We'll provide you with the support and resources you need to make a successful purchase.

title: Bill Blau Real Estate Group
description: CONFIDENTIALITY AGREEMENT × CONFIDENTIALITY AGREEMENT In connection with the proposed acquisition by the undersigned (“Buyer”) of any listings requested from Broker, Bill Blau Real Estate Group (“BBRE”), all proprietary information, including financial condition, operations and prospects of said Business(es)/Property(ies) will be furnished to Buyer from BBRE. In consideration of obtaining said proprietary information, Buyer agrees: That all the proprietary information furnished by BBRE is to be confidential. Seller agrees to receive via email confidential information about Business(es)/Property(ies) from BBRE. Seller desires to maintain the confidentiality of the information of their company, financials and other non-public information and does not want their competitors, employees, customers and others to know their Business(es)/Property(ies) are for sale. To conduct all further inquiries in connection with any Business(es)/Property(ies) received via emails exclusively through BBRE. Buyer further acknowledges that BBRE is first in providing such information to Buyer. If Buyer has received same information from another broker/brokerage agency, Buyer will notify BBRE via email ASAP. Buyer agrees not to attempt to speak to any employees or owners of any Business(es)/Property(ies) referred to by BBRE without prior approval from BBRE. Buyer will not conclude or close any transaction or take title or possession of the Business(es)/Property(ies) until BBRE has received a fully executed Purchase and Sale Agreement. It is further agreed that should Buyer enter into a Purchase and Sale Agreement directly or indirectly with the Seller without BBRE’s written authorization, Buyer and Seller, jointly and severally, agree to pay BBRE’s full commission. Buyer agrees to notify BBRE at least two (2) weeks in advance of when and where the Closing will take place. That unless all parties involved in the proposed acquisition agree in writing, Buyer is not to disclose or reveal any prop

How that moment is set up determines the quality of everything that follows: the listing conversation, the buyer process, the close, and the next referral. BEFORE THE DEAL Getting sellers to call you before they call anyone else The quality of the listing conversation is determined before it starts. By the time a seller reaches out, the competition has already been removed from the equation. Lead Capture Seller Nurture Sequences Education Funnels Lead Source Tracking THE LISTING CONVERSATION Walking in with the work already done When the upstream work is done correctly, the listing conversation is not an interview. The broker is assessing fit. The seller is confirming that what they encountered before the conversation is true in the room. The process, the valuation education, the onboarding approach... all of it has already made the case. Seller Onboarding Valuation Education Virtual Data Room Marketing Material INSIDE THE DEAL A system that moves deals forward without pulling the broker into every step The broker's attention goes where it actually changes the outcome. The broker's first conversation with that buyer is the introduction to the seller.
